role: The air block: id 0, nothing to collide with, nothing to render, nothing to drop.

members.name: getRenderType
members.note: Entry 0 carries render_type -1 (RenderTypeHint -1): the renderer draws nothing.

members.name: getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool
members.note: collide.c's id-0 comment: BlockAir.getCollisionBoundingBoxFromPool returns null, so no box is added.

members.name: canCollideCheck
members.note: Collidable false in the registry; the bucket path never collides with air.

members.name: dropBlockAsItemWithChance
members.note: Empty body in Java: air has no drops.

members.name: BlockAir
members.note: Material air, no bounds, generated into entry 0.

notes: Entry 0 of blocks.h is generated from the live registry, so every property is exact. Movement against air is exercised by every walking snapshot (out/java/snapshots/walk300-s1).
